meta.title: About — Verdant Care
meta.description: Meet the team behind Verdant Care.

story.label: Our story
story.title: Family owned. Rooted in the neighborhood.
paragraphs: Verdant Care started in 2011 with one truck, one mower, and a promise: treat every yard like our own. Fourteen years later we're a tight crew of gardeners, arborists and designers with hundreds of happy neighbors.
We don't chase big commercial contracts. We show up, do careful work, and get invited back season after season.
